## Prettify the triediff PR comment (display-only) and add a guard test. — 2026-08-01 (parent b7c2a2c0ae4f)

**The triediff-comment workflow now prettifies its PR comment into a markdown table via an embedded awk pass, with a new test locking in the transform.**

The `_TEMPLATE` constant in `trie/workflow_install` gains an embedded awk transformer that runs at comment-post time, reformatting the raw on-disk digest into a quieter, scannable PR comment:

- The auto-generated header comment is stripped from display output.
- The `### Changes` bullet list is rendered as a markdown table, with any overflow record folded into the table and the `… and N more` marker dropped.
- The title leads the comment; a footer link to the source file is appended.
- The `Staged` section passes through unmodified.
- The on-disk digest file format is untouched, so all downstream parsers continue to round-trip correctly.
- 'Session digest' wording is renamed to 'triediff' throughout the template.

`test_render_prettifies_digest_for_display_only` (in `tests/test_workflow_install`) extracts the awk program from the rendered workflow YAML and runs it against a canonical digest, asserting each display transform property. It skips automatically if `awk` is not on `PATH`.
